description: Deterministic message instances shared byte-for-byte between the Java and Rust suites. Each entry is one EventRecord population representing one of the lab's four dataset profiles; every codec variant must encode/decode each one to exactly this data (round-trip equality), and the fixed-layout variants (ByteBuffer/FFM in Java, owned/borrowed in Rust) must all agree on the same WIRE_SIZE=70-byte little-endian layout.

smallCommand.note: Minimal message: only id/opcode/flags are meaningful, everything else at its zero default. Exercises the fixed layout's fixed cost even when most fields carry no information.

mediumEvent.note: The representative 'typical' message: id, deviceId, value and timestamp all populated, no repeated or optional fields.

repeatedFields.note: All 8 fixed sample slots populated (sampleCount == MAX_SAMPLES) — exercises the repeated-field region of the layout at full occupancy.

versionedOptionalField.note: version=2 with optionalPresent=true/optionalField set — a v1 reader that ignores optionalPresent and always reads optionalField still gets a well-defined value (0 when absent) because the slot is always reserved in the fixed layout; this is the explicit, non-silent version-evolution story this lab teaches, not a variable-length extension.
